item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days, and will be replaced by a southerly airstream. The weather will be hot during the day and there will also be a few showers over Guangdong during the weekend to midweek next week. Besides, a trough of low pressure is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week.
